payload_fields.threshold_n: 心跳字段: 合力增量阈值(N), 默认 3.0
payload_fields.sides: 心跳字段: {left: {...}, right: {...}} 每侧六维力状态块
payload_fields.sides.left.force: 心跳字段: {fx, fy, fz} 三轴力(N)
payload_fields.sides.left.torque: 心跳字段: {tx, ty, tz} 三轴力矩(N·m)
payload_fields.sides.left.delta_from_baseline: 心跳字段: [dx, dy, dz] 相对 baseline 的增量(N)
payload_fields.sides.left.magnitude: 心跳字段: 合力增量大小(N)
payload_fields.sides.left.contact: 心跳字段: bool, magnitude>=threshold_n 时为 true
payload_fields.sides.left.baseline_status: 心跳字段: learning(启动中) / ready(零点已学习)
payload_fields.sides.right.*: 心跳字段: 同 sides.left, 右臂对应字段
payload_fields.event: 事件对象(仅状态变化时出现, 无事件时不发布)
payload_fields.event.event: 事件类型: contact_left / contact_right / release_left / release_right
payload_fields.event.direction: 方向(仅 contact_*): push_forward / push_back / push_left / push_right / push_up / push_down; release_* 固定为 'release'
payload_fields.event.magnitude: 事件时刻合力增量(N), 保留 3 位小数
payload_fields.event.delta_force: 事件时刻三轴力增量 [dx, dy, dz](N), 相对 baseline, 保留 3 位小数
payload_fields.units: 心跳字段: 各字段单位说明

contact_left.direction: push_forward | push_back | push_left | push_right | push_up | push_down

contact_right.direction: push_forward | push_back | push_left | push_right | push_up | push_down

mcp_tool.name: force_event
mcp_tool.description: 天轶2.0 双臂六维力事件 — 事件驱动, 仅 contact/release 状态变化时发布(无心跳, 无周期心跳)
